:root {

}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body {
  height: 100%;
  font-family: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif;
  background: var(--bg-body);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
body.is-edit-mode .word-card-body {
  display: none;
}
body.is-edit-mode .word-card-toolbar {
  display: none;
}
body.is-edit-mode .search-wrap {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft), var(--shadow-search-wrap);
}
body.is-edit-mode .search-edit-header {
  display: flex;
}
body.is-edit-mode .search-edit-header-right > .copy-status {
  display: flex;
  margin-left: 0;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}
body.is-edit-mode .search-prefix-preview {
  display: none;
}
body.is-edit-mode .search-textarea {
  max-height: 140px;
}
body.is-edit-mode .search-box {
  padding: 4px 12px 12px;
}
body.is-edit-mode .search-wrap {
  order: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
body.is-edit-mode .platform-bar {
  order: 2;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
body.is-edit-mode .stage {
  display: none;
}
body.is-edit-mode .platform-bar::before,
body.is-edit-mode .platform-bar::after {
  display: none;
}
body.is-edit-mode .platform-scroll {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px 6px;
  align-items: start;
  justify-items: center;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  min-height: 56px;
  max-height: min(44vh, 320px);
  padding: 12px 12px 8px;
}
body.is-edit-mode .platform-divider {
  display: none;
}
body.is-edit-mode .platform-pill {
  width: 44px;
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 0 7px;
  justify-self: center;
}
body.is-edit-mode .platform-pill.share {
  padding-bottom: 0;
}
body.is-edit-mode .platform-count-badge {
  top: 6px;
  right: 6px;
}

/* ========== 平台标签栏 ========== */
.platform-bar {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-platform);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-panel);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.platform-bar::before,
.platform-bar::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 20px;
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.platform-bar::before {
  left: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-platform), transparent);
}
.platform-bar::after {
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--bg-platform), transparent);
}
.platform-scroll {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding: 12px 36px 8px var(--space-md);
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.platform-count-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 7px;
  right: 9px;
  z-index: 3;
  min-width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  padding: 0 5px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--text-on-accent);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  pointer-events: none;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(22, 24, 28, 0.14);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.72);
  transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease-out), transform 0.28s var(--ease-spring);
}
.platform-count-badge.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}
.platform-count-badge[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}
.platform-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.platform-pill {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 52px;
  padding: 0 0 7px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  overflow: visible;
  opacity: 0.74;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition:
    transform 0.2s var(--ease-spring),
    color 0.22s var(--ease-out),
    opacity 0.22s var(--ease-out);
}
.platform-pill::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.35);
  transition:
    opacity 0.2s var(--ease-out),
    transform 0.3s var(--ease-spring);
}
.platform-pill:active {
  transform: scale(0.9);
}
.platform-pill.active {
  opacity: 1;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.platform-pill.active svg {
  transform: scale(1.06);
}
.platform-pill.active::after {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
}
.platform-pill.active:active {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}
.platform-pill.active:active svg {
  transform: scale(1);
}
.platform-pill.share.active {
  opacity: 1;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.platform-pill svg {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: scale(1);
  transform-origin: center center;
  overflow: visible;
  transition: transform 0.28s var(--ease-spring);
}
.platform-pill[data-platform="淘宝"] svg {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
}
.platform-pill[data-platform="日历"] svg,
.platform-pill[data-platform="备忘录"] svg,
.platform-pill[data-platform="提醒事项"] svg {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
}
.platform-pill.share {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding-bottom: 0;
}
.platform-pill.share::after {
  display: none;
}
.platform-divider {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 1px;
  height: 28px;
  margin: 0 2px;
  background: var(--divider-platform);
}
.platform-pill.platform-settings-btn {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  opacity: 0.82;
}
.platform-pill.platform-settings-btn::after {
  display: none;
}
.platform-pill.is-tool-hidden {
  display: none !important;
}
.platform-settings-modal {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: min(380px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  height: min(90vh, 660px);
  max-height: min(90vh, 660px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--bg-modal);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-modal-glass);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45) inset,
    0 24px 64px rgba(22, 24, 28, 0.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%);
  animation: infoModalIn 0.28s var(--ease-spring);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.platform-settings-head {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 8px 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}
.platform-settings-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 44px;
}
.platform-settings-head h3 {
  flex: 1;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-modal-title);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: -0.2px;
}
.platform-settings-icon-btn {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.15s var(--ease-spring);
}
.platform-settings-icon-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.92);
  background: var(--bg-word-chip-active);
}
.platform-settings-icon-btn svg {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.platform-settings-icon-btn-confirm {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.platform-settings-icon-btn-confirm:active {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
}
.platform-settings-hint {
  margin: 4px 14px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-align: center;
}
.platform-settings-theme {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 0 16px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}
.platform-settings-theme-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  letter-spacing: -0.1px;
}
.platform-settings-theme-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.theme-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, transform 0.12s var(--ease-spring);
}
.theme-option:active {
  transform: scale(0.98);
}
.theme-option.active {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
}
.theme-swatch {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .theme-swatch {
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  }
}
.platform-settings-list {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.platform-settings-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 52px;
  padding: 8px 16px 8px 14px;
  transition: background 0.15s, opacity 0.2s;
}
.platform-settings-row.is-unchecked {
  opacity: 0.42;
}
.platform-settings-row.is-dragging {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  opacity: 1;
  touch-action: none;
}
.platform-settings-check {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  margin: 0;
  accent-color: var(--accent);
}
.platform-settings-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.platform-settings-icon svg {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.platform-settings-name {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  letter-spacing: -0.12px;
}
.platform-settings-drag {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: grab;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0;
  touch-action: none;
}
.platform-settings-drag:active {
  background: var(--bg-word-chip-active);
}
.platform-settings-drag svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
/* ========== 主内容区 ========== */
.main-panel {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--stack-gap);
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--layout-max);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--space-md)) var(--space-md) 0;
}

/* ========== 搜索框 ========== */
.search-wrap {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-search-wrap);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-panel);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease-out);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.search-edit-header {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 12px 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.search-edit-header-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

function isRarePunctuation(ch) {
  if (!ch || ch.length === 0) return false;
  if (COMMON_PUNCT_RE.test(ch)) return false;
  var cp = ch.codePointAt(0);
  if (cp >= 0x4E00 && cp <= 0x9FFF) return false;
  if (cp >= 0x3400 && cp <= 0x4DBF) return false;
  if ((cp >= 0x41 && cp <= 0x5A) || (cp >= 0x61 && cp <= 0x7A)) return false;
  if (cp >= 0x30 && cp <= 0x39) return false;
  if (/\s/.test(ch)) return false;
  if (cp <= 0x7F && /[.,!?;:'"()\[\]{}<>\/\\@#&%*+=_|\-~]/.test(ch)) return false;
  if (cp >= 0x2010 && cp <= 0x2027) return false;
  if (cp === 0x2026 || cp === 0x2014 || cp === 0x2013) return false;
  if (cp >= 0x3001 && cp <= 0x3017) return false;
  if (cp >= 0xFF01 && cp <= 0xFF0F) return false;
  if (cp >= 0xFF1A && cp <= 0xFF20) return false;
  if (cp >= 0xFF3B && cp <= 0xFF65) return false;
  if (cp >= 0x1F000 && cp <= 0x1FAFF) return true;
  if (cp >= 0x1F3FB && cp <= 0x1F3FF) return true;
  if (cp >= 0x1F1E6 && cp <= 0x1F1FF) return true;
  return (cp >= 0x2000 && cp <= 0x206F) ||
    (cp >= 0x2190 && cp <= 0x21FF) ||
    (cp >= 0x2300 && cp <= 0x23FF) ||
    (cp >= 0x2460 && cp <= 0x24FF) ||
    (cp >= 0x2500 && cp <= 0x27BF) ||
    (cp >= 0x2B00 && cp <= 0x2BFF) ||
    (cp >= 0xFE00 && cp <= 0xFE0F) ||
    (cp >= 0xFE10 && cp <= 0xFE2F) ||
    (cp >= 0xFFF0 && cp <= 0xFFFF) ||

function stripRarePunctuation(text) {

  var indices = Array.from(baseSelected).sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
  var parts = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < indices.length; i++) parts.push(segments[indices[i]]);
  return parts.join("");
}

function getOutputText() {
  if (isEditMode && searchTextarea && searchTextarea.style.display !== "none") {
    var editVal = sanitizeText(searchTextarea.value);
    return editVal || null;
  }
  if (editedText !== null) return editedText;
  return getSelectedText();
}

function getTextForEdit() {

  if (editedText !== null) return editedText;

}

// ==================== 剪贴板 ====================
function syncClipboard(text, options) {
  options = options || {};
  var refocusTextarea = isEditMode && searchTextarea && document.activeElement === searchTextarea;
  if (refocusTextarea && !options.keepEditFocus) {
    suppressEditBlurCopy = true;
    try {
      searchTextarea.blur();
    } finally {
      suppressEditBlurCopy = false;
    }
  }
  clipBoard.value = text;
  clipBoard.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  clipBoard.setSelectionRange(0, clipBoard.value.length);
  var success = false;
  try { success = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (e) {}
  clipBoard.blur();
  if (refocusTextarea && options.keepEditFocus) {
    searchTextarea.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  return success;
}

function buildPayload() {
  var text = getOutputText();
  if (!text) return "";
  var platforms = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".platform-pill.active[data-platform]:not(.is-tool-hidden)"))
    .map(function(btn) { return btn.dataset.platform; });
  return JSON.stringify({ source: "text-door-v2", text: text, platforms: platforms });
}

function doCopy() {
  var payload = buildPayload();
  if (!payload) {
    var cancelled = syncClipboard("TEXT_DOOR_V2_PENDING");
    if (cancelled) clearPending();
    else { pendingText = "TEXT_DOOR_V2_PENDING"; refreshCopyHintUI(); }
    return cancelled;
  }
  var ok = syncClipboard(payload);
  if (isEditMode) {
    if (ok) {
      lastSyncedEditText = sanitizeText(searchTextarea.value);
      editedText = lastSyncedEditText || null;
      clearPending();
    }
    refreshCopyHintUI();
    return ok;
  }
  if (ok) {
    clearPending();
  } else {
    pendingText = payload;
    refreshCopyHintUI();
  }
  return ok;
}

// ==================== 提示 ====================
function tryCopyPending(options) {
  options = options || {};
  var payload = pendingText || (isEditNeedsTap() ? buildPayload() : null);
  if (!payload) return false;
  var ok = syncClipboard(payload, { keepEditFocus: !!options.avoidRefocus });
  if (ok) {
    if (isEditMode) {
      lastSyncedEditText = sanitizeText(searchTextarea.value);
      editedText = lastSyncedEditText || null;
      if (!options.avoidRefocus) {
        searchTextarea.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    }
    clearPending();
    updateSearchText();
    refreshCopyHintUI();
  }
  return ok;
}

function loadPlatformLayout() {
  var defaults = buildDefaultPlatformLayout();
  var defaultIds = defaults.map(function(item) { return item.id; });
  try {
    var raw = localStorage.getItem(PLATFORM_LAYOUT_KEY);
    if (!raw) return defaults;
    var saved = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!saved || !saved.length) return defaults;
    var map = {};
    defaults.forEach(function(item) { map[item.id] = true; });
    var merged = [];
    saved.forEach(function(item) {
      if (item && item.id && item.id !== "share" && item.id !== "待办" && map[item.id]) {
        merged.push({ id: item.id, visible: item.visible !== false });
        delete map[item.id];
      }
    });
    defaults.forEach(function(item) {
      if (map[item.id]) merged.push({ id: item.id, visible: true });
    });
    return merged;
  } catch (e) {
    return defaults;
  }
}

function settingsRowFromPoint(y) {
  if (!platformSettingsList) return null;
  var rows = platformSettingsList.querySelectorAll(".platform-settings-row");
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  var listRect = platformSettingsList.getBoundingClientRect();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var rect = rows[i].getBoundingClientRect();
    if (y >= rect.top && y <= rect.bottom) return rows[i];
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
    var rowRect = rows[j].getBoundingClientRect();
    if (y < rowRect.top) return rows[j];
  }

  if (y <= listRect.top) return rows[0];
  return rows[rows.length - 1];
}

function settingsReorderAtY(y) {
  if (!settingsDragRow || !platformSettingsList) return;
  var target = settingsRowFromPoint(y);
  if (!target || target === settingsDragRow) return;
  var rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
  var before = y < rect.top + rect.height / 2;
  platformSettingsList.insertBefore(
    settingsDragRow,
    before ? target : target.nextSibling
  );
}

function stopSettingsAutoScroll() {
  if (settingsAutoScrollRaf) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(settingsAutoScrollRaf);
    settingsAutoScrollRaf = null;
  }
}

function settingsAutoScrollTick() {
  settingsAutoScrollRaf = null;
  if (!settingsDragRow || !platformSettingsList) return;

  var y = settingsDragY;
  var rect = platformSettingsList.getBoundingClientRect();
  var delta = 0;

  if (y < rect.top + SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE) {
    var topRatio = (rect.top + SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE - y) / SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE;
    delta = -Math.ceil(SETTINGS_SCROLL_SPEED * Math.min(1, topRatio));
  } else if (y > rect.bottom - SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE) {
    var bottomRatio = (y - (rect.bottom - SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE)) / SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE;
    delta = Math.ceil(SETTINGS_SCROLL_SPEED * Math.min(1, bottomRatio));
  }

  if (delta !== 0) {
    platformSettingsList.scrollTop += delta;
  }
  settingsReorderAtY(y);

  var inEdge = y < rect.top + SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE || y > rect.bottom - SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE;
  if (inEdge && settingsDragRow) {
    settingsAutoScrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(settingsAutoScrollTick);
  }
}

function settingsDragMove(y) {
  if (!settingsDragRow || !platformSettingsList) return;
  settingsDragY = y;
  settingsReorderAtY(y);

  var rect = platformSettingsList.getBoundingClientRect();
  var inEdge = y < rect.top + SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE || y > rect.bottom - SETTINGS_SCROLL_EDGE;
  if (inEdge) {
    if (!settingsAutoScrollRaf) {
      settingsAutoScrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(settingsAutoScrollTick);
    }
  } else {
    stopSettingsAutoScroll();
  }
}

function bindPlatformSettingsDrag() {
  if (!platformSettingsList) return;

  function endSettingsDrag() {
    stopSettingsAutoScroll();
    if (settingsDragRow) settingsDragRow.classList.remove("is-dragging");
    settingsDragRow = null;
    settingsDragId = null;
  }

  platformSettingsList.addEventListener("touchstart", function(e) {
    var handle = e.target.closest(".platform-settings-drag");
    if (!handle) return;
    settingsDragRow = handle.closest(".platform-settings-row");
    if (!settingsDragRow) return;
    settingsDragId = settingsDragRow.dataset.toolId;
    settingsDragY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    settingsDragRow.classList.add("is-dragging");
  }, { passive: true, capture: true });

  document.addEventListener("touchmove", function(e) {
    if (!settingsDragRow || !platformSettingsList) return;
    if (!platformSettingsList.contains(settingsDragRow)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    settingsDragMove(e.touches[0].clientY);
  }, { passive: false });

  document.addEventListener("touchend", endSettingsDrag, { passive: true });
  document.addEventListener("touchcancel", endSettingsDrag, { passive: true });
}

function enterEditMode() {
  if (isEditMode && searchTextarea.style.display !== "none") return;
  
  if (!isEditMode) {
    isEditMode = true;
    document.body.classList.add("is-edit-mode");
    savedSelection = new Set(baseSelected);
    editSnapshotRawText = rawText;
    editSnapshotSegments = segments.slice();
    editSnapshotSelection = new Set(baseSelected);
  }

  preEditText = getTextForEdit();
  lastSyncedEditText = preEditText;
  mountCopyStatusForEdit();
  searchText.style.display = "none";
  searchTextarea.style.display = "block";
  searchTextarea.value = sanitizeText(preEditText);
  autoResizeTextarea();
  searchTextarea.focus();
  refreshCopyHintUI();
}

function backToSelectMode() {
  if (!isEditMode) return;
  isEditMode = false;
  document.body.classList.remove("is-edit-mode");
  
  var currentEditText = sanitizeText(searchTextarea.value);
  var hadChanges = currentEditText !== preEditText;

  editedText = null;
  if (hadChanges) {
    rawText = currentEditText;
    segments = segment(rawText);
    baseSelected = new Set(segments.map(function(_, i) { return i; }));
    savedSelection = null;
    renderWords();
  } else if (savedSelection) {
    baseSelected = savedSelection;
    savedSelection = null;
  }
  renderSelection();
  
  preEditText = null;
  editSnapshotRawText = null;
  editSnapshotSegments = null;
  editSnapshotSelection = null;
  
  searchTextarea.value = "";
  searchTextarea.style.display = "none";
  searchText.style.display = "block";

  lastSyncedEditText = null;
  updateSearchText();
  doCopy();
  mountCopyStatusForSelect();
  refreshCopyHintUI();
}

function autoResizeTextarea() {
  searchTextarea.style.height = "auto";
  var cap = isEditMode ? Math.min(window.innerHeight * 0.52, 320) : 160;
  var newHeight = Math.min(Math.max(searchTextarea.scrollHeight, 24), cap);
  searchTextarea.style.height = newHeight + "px";
}

searchTextarea.addEventListener("input", function() {
  autoResizeTextarea();
  syncEditCopyPending();
});

function maybeCopyOnEditBoxTap() {
  if (!isEditMode || (!pendingText && !isEditNeedsTap())) return false;
  return tryCopyPending();
}

searchBox.addEventListener("click", function() {
  if (isEditMode) {
    maybeCopyOnEditBoxTap();
    return;
  }
  enterEditMode();
});

searchTextarea.addEventListener("touchend", function() {
  maybeCopyOnEditBoxTap();
});

function commitEditCopyFromKeyboard(e) {
  if (!isEditMode || (!pendingText && !isEditNeedsTap())) return false;
  if (e) e.preventDefault();
  suppressEditBlurCopy = true;
  var ok = tryCopyPending({ avoidRefocus: true });
  window.setTimeout(function() {
    suppressEditBlurCopy = false;
  }, 0);
  return ok;
}

searchTextarea.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
  if (e.key !== "Enter" || e.shiftKey || e.isComposing) return;
  commitEditCopyFromKeyboard(e);
});

searchTextarea.addEventListener("blur", function() {
  if (suppressEditBlurCopy || !isEditMode) return;
  if (!pendingText && !isEditNeedsTap()) return;
  tryCopyPending({ avoidRefocus: true });
});

document.addEventListener("touchend", function(e) {
  if (!isEditMode || (!pendingText && !isEditNeedsTap())) return;
  var target = e.target.closest ? e.target : e.target.parentNode;
  if (!target.closest) return;
  if (target.closest(".search-textarea")) return;
  if (target.closest(".copy-hint-info")) return;
  if (target.closest(".search-edit-header")) return;
  if (target.closest(".word-card-toolbar")) return;
  if (target.closest(".platform-bar")) return;
  if (target.closest(".modal-overlay")) return;
  if (target.closest(".platform-pill")) return;
  tryCopyPending();
}, { passive: false });

// ==================== 触摸事件 - 绑定到 wordLayer ====================

wordLayer.addEventListener("touchstart", function(e) {
  var word = e.target.closest(".word");
  if (!word) { dragStartIdx = -1; return; }
  
  var t = e.touches[0];
  dragStartIdx = parseInt(word.dataset.index);
  isDragging = false;
  dragStartX = t.clientX;
  dragStartY = t.clientY;
  dragMode = baseSelected.has(dragStartIdx) ? "remove" : "add";
}, {passive: true});

wordLayer.addEventListener("touchmove", function(e) {
  if (dragStartIdx === -1) return;
  
  var t = e.touches[0];
  if (!isDragging) {
    if (Math.hypot(t.clientX - dragStartX, t.clientY - dragStartY) > DRAG_THRESHOLD) {
      isDragging = true;
    }
  }
  if (isDragging) {
    e.preventDefault();
    updateDragMarquee(t.clientX, t.clientY);
    var word = wordFromPoint(t.clientX, t.clientY);
    if (word) updateDragRange(dragStartIdx, parseInt(word.dataset.index));
  }
}, {passive: false});

wordLayer.addEventListener("touchend", function(e) {
  if (dragStartIdx === -1) return;
  
  if (isDragging) {
    commitDrag();
    doCopy();
    suppressClick = true;
    setTimeout(function() { suppressClick = false; }, 120);
  } else {
    toggleOne(dragStartIdx);
  }
  resetDrag();
}, {passive: true});

wordLayer.addEventListener("touchcancel", function() {
  if (dragStartIdx !== -1) {
    dragSelected.clear();
    renderSelection();
    resetDrag();
  } else {
    hideDragMarquee();
  }
});

wordLayer.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
  if (suppressClick) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    suppressClick = false;
  }
}, true);

// ==================== 点击空白处完成拷贝 ====================
document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
  if (!pendingText && !isEditNeedsTap()) return;

  var target = e.target;
  if (!isEditMode && target.closest(".word")) return;
  if (target.closest(".platform-pill")) return;
  if (target.closest(".copy-hint-info")) return;
  if (target.closest(".word-card-toolbar")) return;
  if (target.closest(".platform-bar")) return;
  if (target.closest(".modal-overlay")) return;
  if (isEditMode) {
    if (target.closest(".search-textarea")) {
      maybeCopyOnEditBoxTap();
      return;
    }
    if (target.closest(".search-edit-header")) return;
  } else if (target.closest(".search-wrap")) {
    return;
  }

  tryCopyPending();
});

// ==================== 说明弹窗 ====================
function setInfoPage(index, smooth, fromScroll) {
  if (!infoPagesViewport || !infoPages.length) return;
  infoPageIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, infoPages.length - 1));
  var page = infoPages[infoPageIndex];
  if (noteModalTitle && page) {
    noteModalTitle.textContent = page.getAttribute("data-page-title") || "关于大爆炸";
  }
  if (infoPageDots) {
    infoPageDots.querySelectorAll(".info-page-dot").forEach(function(dot, i) {
      dot.classList.toggle("active", i === infoPageIndex);
      dot.setAttribute("aria-current", i === infoPageIndex ? "true" : "false");
    });
  }
  if (!fromScroll) {
    infoPagesViewport.scrollTo({
      left: infoPageIndex * infoPagesViewport.clientWidth,
      behavior: smooth ? "smooth" : "auto"
    });
  }
}

function initInfoPages() {
  if (!infoPageDots || !infoPages.length) return;
  infoPageDots.innerHTML = "";
  for (var i = 0; i < infoPages.length; i++) {
    var dot = document.createElement("button");
    dot.type = "button";
    dot.className = "info-page-dot" + (i === 0 ? " active" : "");
    dot.setAttribute("aria-label", "第 " + (i + 1) + " 页");
    dot.setAttribute("aria-current", i === 0 ? "true" : "false");
    (function(idx) {
      dot.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        setInfoPage(idx, true);
      });
    })(i);
    infoPageDots.appendChild(dot);
  }
  if (infoPagesViewport) {
    infoPagesViewport.addEventListener("scroll", function() {
      if (!infoPagesViewport.clientWidth) return;
      var idx = Math.round(infoPagesViewport.scrollLeft / infoPagesViewport.clientWidth);
      if (idx !== infoPageIndex) setInfoPage(idx, false, true);
    }, { passive: true });
  }
}

function closeModal() {
  if (modalOverlayTribute) modalOverlayTribute.classList.remove("show");
  if (modalOverlayPending) modalOverlayPending.classList.remove("show");
}

function shouldOpenPendingModal() {
  if (isEditMode) return isEditNeedsTap();
  return !!pendingText;
}

function openTributeModal() {
  closeModal();
  requestAnimationFrame(function() {
    setInfoPage(0, false);
  });
  if (modalOverlayTribute) modalOverlayTribute.classList.add("show");
}

function openPendingModal() {
  closeModal();
  if (modalOverlayPending) modalOverlayPending.classList.add("show");
}

if (hintInfoBtn) {
  hintInfoBtn.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (shouldOpenPendingModal()) openPendingModal();
    else openTributeModal();
  });
}

if (modalOverlayTribute) {
  modalOverlayTribute.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (e.target === modalOverlayTribute) closeModal();
  });
  var tributeModalEl = modalOverlayTribute.querySelector(".info-modal");
  if (tributeModalEl) {
    tributeModalEl.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
    });
  }
}

if (modalOverlayPending) {
  modalOverlayPending.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (e.target === modalOverlayPending) closeModal();
  });
  var pendingModalEl = modalOverlayPending.querySelector(".info-modal");
  if (pendingModalEl) {
    pendingModalEl.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
    });
  }
}

document.getElementById("restoreOriginalBtn").addEventListener("click", function() {
  if (rawText !== originalText && !window.confirm("恢复识别原文？当前编辑会被替换。")) return;
  rawText = preserveText(originalText);
  segments = segment(rawText);
  baseSelected.clear(); dragSelected.clear(); editedText = null;
  renderWords(); doCopy();
});
if (!rawText.trim()) {
  window.setTimeout(function() { enterEditMode(); }, 0);
}
// ==================== 初始化 ====================
initCopyStatusMount();
initInfoPages();
refreshCopyHintUI();
segments = segment(rawText);
renderWords();
</script>
